title: TrueDamage
description: A very interesting enchantment that can make your weapon damage feel more realistic
body:
This mod adds a new enchantment to the game called True Damage.
It can be applied to weapons that deal damage.
Once enchanted, the weapon will ignore the target’s defense and deal full damage directly.
In case you don’t fully understand, here’s an example:
Suppose your sword deals 9 damage. If the target has armor, the actual damage dealt will be lower than 9 after calculation.
However, if you apply the True Damage enchantment first,
the weapon will ignore all armor values and deal the full 9 damage to the target.
